goal.sl: Napišeš uradno pismo, prošnjo in pritožbo (Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully) in sporočilo prijatelju, razumeš govorjeno britanščino (gonna, gotta, innit) in poznaš britanske besede ob ameriških.
goal.de: Du schreibst einen formellen Brief, eine Bitte und eine Beschwerde (Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully) und eine Mail an Freunde, verstehst gesprochenes Britisch (gonna, gotta, innit) und kennst britische Wörter neben amerikanischen.
goal.it: Scrivi una lettera formale, una richiesta e un reclamo (Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully) e una mail a un amico, capisci il britannico parlato (gonna, gotta, innit) e conosci le parole britanniche accanto a quelle americane.
goal.en: You can write a formal letter, a request and a complaint (Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully) and an email to a friend, understand spoken British (gonna, gotta, innit) and know British words beside American ones.

say.sl: **Dear Sir or Madam,** (Spoštovani) pišeš, kadar ne poznaš imena, na koncu **Yours faithfully,** (Lep pozdrav). Z imenom: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** in **Yours sincerely,**. Američani končajo tudi z **Yours truly,** Za vejico v novi vrstici velika začetnica, ne mala kot v slovenščini.
say.de: **Dear Sir or Madam,** (Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren) schreibst du, wenn du den Namen nicht kennst, am Ende **Yours faithfully,** (Mit freundlichen Grüßen). Mit Namen: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** und **Yours sincerely,**. Amerikaner schließen auch mit **Yours truly,** Nach dem Komma in der neuen Zeile groß, nicht klein wie im Deutschen.
say.it: **Dear Sir or Madam,** (Gentili Signori) lo scrivi quando non sai il nome, alla fine **Yours faithfully,** (Distinti saluti). Con il nome: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** e **Yours sincerely,** (Cordiali saluti). Gli americani chiudono anche con **Yours truly,** Dopo la virgola, a capo, si comincia con la maiuscola.
say.en: **Dear Sir or Madam,** is for when you don't know the name, ending **Yours faithfully,**. With a name: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** and **Yours sincerely,**. Americans also end with **Yours truly,** After the comma, a new line and a capital letter.

say.sl: V uradnem pismu cele oblike: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** (Pišem vam glede avtobusa.) Prošnja: **I would be grateful if you could reply.** Konec: **I look forward to hearing from you.** Daljše besede: **receive** (dobiti, za get), **request** (prositi, za ask for), **inform** (obvestiti, za tell), **require** (potrebovati, za need).
say.de: Im formellen Brief ganze Formen: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** (Ich schreibe Ihnen wegen des Busses.) Die Bitte: **I would be grateful if you could reply.** Der Schluss: **I look forward to hearing from you.** Längere Wörter: **receive** (erhalten, statt get), **request** (ersuchen, statt ask for), **inform** (mitteilen, statt tell), **require** (benötigen, statt need).
say.it: In una lettera formale forme intere: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** (Le scrivo a proposito dell'autobus.) La richiesta: **I would be grateful if you could reply.** La fine: **I look forward to hearing from you.** Parole più lunghe: **receive** (ricevere, per get), **request** (richiedere, per ask for), **inform** (informare, per tell), **require** (necessitare, per need).
say.en: A formal letter has whole forms: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** The request: **I would be grateful if you could reply.** The end: **I look forward to hearing from you.** Longer words: **receive** for get, **request** for ask for, **inform** for tell, **require** for need.

say.sl: Pritožba pove, kaj, kdaj in kaj želiš: **I am writing to complain about the bus.** (Pišem, da se pritožim zaradi avtobusa.) Kaj želiš: **I would like a refund.** Prošnja je bolj vljudna z več besedami: **Could you send me the timetable?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I was wondering if you could help.** Vljudno slabo novico: **I'm afraid the bus was late.**
say.de: Eine Beschwerde sagt, was, wann und was du willst: **I am writing to complain about the bus.** (Ich möchte mich über den Bus beschweren.) Was du willst: **I would like a refund.** Eine Bitte wird mit mehr Wörtern höflicher: **Could you send me the timetable?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I was wondering if you could help.** Höflich eine schlechte Nachricht: **I'm afraid the bus was late.**
say.it: Un reclamo dice che cosa, quando e che cosa vuoi: **I am writing to complain about the bus.** (Le scrivo per lamentarmi dell'autobus.) Che cosa vuoi: **I would like a refund.** Una richiesta è più cortese con più parole: **Could you send me the timetable?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I was wondering if you could help.** Con garbo una brutta notizia: **I'm afraid the bus was late.**
say.en: A complaint says what, when and what you want: **I am writing to complain about the bus.** What you want: **I would like a refund.** A request grows politer with more words: **Could you send me the timetable?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I was wondering if you could help.** Bad news, politely: **I'm afraid the bus was late.**

say.sl: **Hi Jack,** pišeš prijatelju, z **Hello** ali **Hi**. **Thanks for the photos!** (Hvala za fotografije.) Kratke oblike, osebek lahko odpade: **Hope you're well.** **Can't wait to see you!** Na koncu **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Best wishes**, **Cheers**, **Love**. **Thanks** je prijateljsko, **Thank you** vljudno.
say.de: **Hi Jack,** schreibst du an Freunde, mit **Hello** oder **Hi**. **Thanks for the photos!** (Danke für die Fotos.) Kurzformen, das Subjekt kann wegfallen: **Hope you're well.** **Can't wait to see you!** Am Ende **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Best wishes**, **Cheers**, **Love**. **Thanks** ist unter Freunden, **Thank you** höflich.
say.it: **Hi Jack,** lo scrivi a un amico, con **Hello** o **Hi**. **Thanks for the photos!** (Grazie per le foto.) Forme brevi, il soggetto può cadere: **Hope you're well.** **Can't wait to see you!** Alla fine **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Best wishes**, **Cheers**, **Love**. **Thanks** è tra amici, **Thank you** è cortese.
say.en: **Hi Jack,** is for a friend, with **Hello** or **Hi**. **Thanks for the photos!** Short forms, and the subject can go: **Hope you're well.** **Can't wait to see you!** At the end **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Best wishes**, **Cheers**, **Love**. **Thanks** is between friends, **Thank you** is polite.

say.sl: Govorjena britanščina, da jo razumeš, ne za pismo: **gonna** (going to), **gotta** (got to), **wanna** (want to), **dunno** (don't know), **innit** (isn't it), **ta**, **cheers** (hvala). **I'm gonna be late.** (Zamudil{m:|f:a} bom.) **mate** in **love** sta nagovora. V Cumbrii **aye** (ja), **lad**, **lass**, na zahodu **marra** (prijatelj). V govoru je vse prav.
say.de: Gesprochenes Britisch, zum Verstehen, nicht für den Brief: **gonna** (going to), **gotta** (got to), **wanna** (want to), **dunno** (don't know), **innit** (isn't it), **ta**, **cheers** (danke). **I'm gonna be late.** (Ich komme zu spät.) **mate** und **love** sind Anreden. In Cumbria **aye** (ja), **lad**, **lass**, im Westen **marra** (Freund). Gesprochen ist alles richtig.
say.it: Britannico parlato, da capire, non per una lettera: **gonna** (going to), **gotta** (got to), **wanna** (want to), **dunno** (don't know), **innit** (isn't it), **ta**, **cheers** (grazie). **I'm gonna be late.** (Farò tardi.) **mate** e **love** servono per rivolgersi a qualcuno. In Cumbria **aye** (sì), **lad**, **lass**, a ovest **marra** (amico). A voce va tutto bene.
say.en: Spoken British, for you to understand, not for a letter: **gonna** (going to), **gotta** (got to), **wanna** (want to), **dunno** (don't know), **innit** (isn't it), **ta**, **cheers** (thanks). **I'm gonna be late.** **mate** and **love** call someone. In Cumbria **aye** (yes), **lad**, **lass**, in the west **marra** (friend). In talk it's all right.

say.sl: Britanija in Amerika imata svoje besede: **lift** (dvigalo, ameriško **elevator**), **flat** (**apartment**), **lorry** (**truck**), **petrol** (**gas**), **autumn** (**fall**), **holiday** (**vacation**), **chips** (**fries**), **pavement** (**sidewalk**). Tudi zapis: **colour**, **color**; **centre**, **center**. Oboje je prav, naš tečaj govori britansko.
say.de: Britannien und Amerika haben eigene Wörter: **lift** (Aufzug, amerikanisch **elevator**), **flat** (**apartment**), **lorry** (**truck**), **petrol** (**gas**), **autumn** (**fall**), **holiday** (**vacation**), **chips** (**fries**), **pavement** (**sidewalk**). Auch die Schreibung: **colour**, **color**; **centre**, **center**. Beides ist richtig, unser Kurs spricht britisch.
say.it: Gran Bretagna e America hanno parole proprie: **lift** (ascensore, in americano **elevator**), **flat** (**apartment**), **lorry** (**truck**), **petrol** (**gas**), **autumn** (**fall**), **holiday** (**vacation**), **chips** (**fries**), **pavement** (**sidewalk**). Anche la grafia: **colour**, **color**; **centre**, **center**. Vanno bene tutti e due, il nostro corso parla britannico.
say.en: Britain and America have their own words: **lift** (**elevator**), **flat** (**apartment**), **lorry** (**truck**), **petrol** (**gas**), **autumn** (**fall**), **holiday** (**vacation**), **chips** (**fries**), **pavement** (**sidewalk**). Spelling too: **colour**, **color**; **centre**, **center**. Both are right; this course speaks British.

exercises.text: Dear Sir or ___, I am ___ to complain about the bus to Keswick. It has been late every day this month. I would be ___ if you could look into this. I look forward to ___ from you. Yours ___, Mrs Birkett

accept: Madam
writing
grateful
thankful
hearing
faithfully
truly

translation.sl: Spoštovani, pišem, da se pritožim zaradi avtobusa v Keswick. Ta mesec je vsak dan zamujal. Hvaležna bi bila, če bi to raziskali. Veselim se vašega odgovora. Lep pozdrav, gospa Birkett
translation.de: Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren, ich möchte mich über den Bus nach Keswick beschweren. Er hatte diesen Monat jeden Tag Verspätung. Ich wäre Ihnen dankbar, wenn Sie das prüfen könnten. Ich freue mich auf Ihre Antwort. Mit freundlichen Grüßen, Mrs Birkett
translation.it: Gentili Signori, vi scrivo per lamentarmi dell'autobus per Keswick. Questo mese è stato in ritardo ogni giorno. Vi sarei grata se poteste verificare. Resto in attesa di una vostra risposta. Distinti saluti, la signora Birkett
translation.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the bus to Keswick. It has been late every day this month. I would be grateful if you could look into this. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, Mrs Birkett
